The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

At `origin/main` the map had seven keys, so the ADR-0087 entry's "three of its seven entries" is accurate. Nothing removed beyond the three entries.

The replacement block is weight-bearing by construction: `hasOwnProperty` false per key; an `Object.entries` sweep by `path` against the three paths; `Object.keys(...).sort()` equals the four-name list. The PR's ablation (3 of 4 red on a re-planted entry, restore proven) is consistent with this static reading; not re-run.

At head the three paths survive only where required: the changeset FROM column, the absence pin, the removal-site comment, the ADR-0087 entry/registry. `resolveDependencies`/`uploadArtifact` hits in `packages/core/src/{kernel,kernel-base,lite-kernel,plugin-loader}.ts` and `packages/spec/src/contracts/package-service.ts` are the kernel plugin-sort method and `IPackageService` methods — a different surface, correctly untouched.

10. ADR-0087 D3 entry — RIGHT: all five `SemanticMigration` fields; filename satisfies `build-migration-registry.ts`; the `registry.ts` block equals the entry body; step-18 ids in sorted order.
11. "objectui pin names none" — `.objectui-sha` = `62597c58…`; 0 files for `PackageApiContracts`, each key, each path; controls fire (14 / 34).
